init.description: Choose what to configure. Guest credentials power Guest Operations: run programs, transfer files and query the registry inside the guest OS through VMware Tools.

data.console_base_url: Console access URL (fill when using port mapping/reverse proxy, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:18123; blank = auto)
data.short_entity_ids: Rename entities to short fixed entity_ids (e.g. switch.ha_power)
data.update_interval: Data refresh interval (seconds) - how often data is pulled from ESXi

general.description: Configure state attributes for datastore/license sensors, the VM screenshot interval, short entity_ids, the entity-aggregate snapshot refresh interval, and the data refresh interval for pulling from ESXi.

data.password: Guest password (leave blank to keep the stored password)
data.remove: Remove the guest credentials for this VM

error.invalid_console_base: Invalid console access URL: must start with http:// or https:// and include a host, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:18123; leave blank to auto-detect
